summary: Visible Host transport/reconciliation rejected a completed quality result and blocked review submission and repair dispatch

expected.reviewSubmission: completed result should be accepted by the bound Host adapter and committed for downstream repair planning
expected.lifecycle: quality review should reach the Submission phase or return a deterministic actionable error

actual.lifecycleEffect: completed review result did not pass Host transport/reconciliation, so Submission and automatic repair could not start

steps: Run h:engine quality V3.8.4 with the bound visible Coordinator and Host collaboration adapter.
Complete the read-only review and return the structured result.
Observe Host transport/reconciliation failures CODEX_HOST_RESPONSE_JSON_INVALID and CODEX_HOST_RESPONSE_BINDING_MISMATCH while delivering the result.
Observe that the review Submission is not committed and repair dispatch does not start.
